rules: Long TS windows (~200-252 days) on return/high/low failed the coverage gate in all 3 attempts this round (0.871-0.899, all below the 0.90 floor) - these windows starve coverage via rolling-window NaNs on shorter-history names, so avoid them.

Return signals scaled or interacted with their own realized volatility (TS_STD($return,...)) failed cheap_screen in all 3 attempts this round (t=0.49-0.88) across 5-40 day windows - deprioritize return x return-vol combinations.

Return interacted with accrual_gap sign or roe rank failed cheap_screen (t=0.08, 0.94), while return interacted with operating_margin was this round's only acceptance - the fundamental chosen matters more than merely adding an interaction; favor profitability/margin fundamentals over accrual/roe.

The 21-day close-position-in-high/low-range family (($close-TS_MIN($low,21))/(TS_MAX($high,21)-TS_MIN($low,21))) is saturated and load-bearing: a 5-day variant hit 0.898 correlation, a close-mean variant shared 9 archive nodes, and a close-only simplification lost 56% of parent IC. Stop proposing near-variants or simplifications of it.
TS_ARGMAX/TS_ARGMIN of price extremes failed twice this round at different gates (40-day: cheap_screen; 200-day: coverage) - no evidence yet that standalone extremum-timing adds value.
SIGN($accrual_gap) as a multiplicative gate on summed return scored far worse (t=0.08) than any other rejection this round - treat it as actively destructive, not merely unhelpful.

This round's only acceptance paired a short (3-day) decayed return with a fundamental z-score (operating_margin), not another price/return term - favor return x fundamental-zscore pairings over return x price-extreme or return x return-vol.
